thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/15/2019: ZIXI, GSIT, RTEC, MSFT, IBM, CSCO, AAPL, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/15/2019: ZIXI, GSIT, RTEC, MSFT, IBM, CSCO, AAPL, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.56%
AAPL: +0.10%
IBM: +0.20%
CSCO: Flat
GOOG: Flat
Technology stocks were climbing in Tuesday's pre-market trading .
In sector news:
(+) Zix ( ZIXI ) was slightly higher after announcing an agreement to acquire AppRiver for $275 million in cash.
(+) GSI Technology ( GSIT ) was marginally higher as it raised its revenue guidance for fiscal Q3 to between $14.6 million and $14.8 million, with gross margin of approximately 66% to 68%, based on its preliminary financial results for the period.
(=) Rudolph Technologies ( RTEC ) was flat after it secured more than $15 million in orders of legacy and new process control systems from a chip maker based in Asia.
